background.source: procedural — 8 stone pillars with glowing caps, veined dark sky (inside of the head), inscribed gold trial ring on the platform

canon: CANON.md §1: Octagonal Shrine Par-fang (Central Mountain) — The Source. Element: Earth. Eight-sided, ancient, still. The sky above is the inside of the head — dark, vast, veined. Inscription: Fight. Die. Return. Claim the forces. Forge the katana. Become whole.
description: Eight-sided, ancient, still. The sky above is the inside of the head — dark, vast, veined. The trial is inscribed in stone here.

lighting.note: Still, old light. Nothing flickers here.

name: OCTAGONAL SHRINE PAR-FANG
